version_bump.why: library audit --base main (check.yml versions and audit jobs) raises library.version-rule for any item whose files changed since v1.0.0 without a higher version; the viewer-asset renewal above changed the four record.toml files. The version is part of the record digest, so the bump changes the digests and the reviews were accepted again.
version_bump.decision: relayed by the coordinating Fenolite session (Master) on 2026-11-05 as the maintainer's choice (option A): bump to 1.0.1 and re-accept, provided the version field is the only change

No generated definition, geometry, pin, pad or other field changed (git diff of the bump: only those version lines).
